proofUses.reason: Four rectangle crossings make an annular circuit. Harris extends an arbitrary arm through a circuit and a crossing from its interior; separated closed-dual annuli give the upper scale bound by independence.

Two disjoint endpoint boxes give the upper bound. Long arms through one common surrounding circuit give the lower bound by Harris; doubling compares scales. Uniform constants identify the logarithmic exponents without assuming power comparisons.

Written proof following Bollobás–Riordan (arXiv:math/0410359v3): a parity crossing lemma and planar duality give probability 1/2 for the self-dual rectangle; conditioning on the closed dual cluster of the left side, reflection and Harris give RSW; closed dual strip crossings in disjoint annuli give no percolation at 1/2, and sharpness excludes p_c>1/2.
